EIFEL & MOSEL

Your next story
starts outside.

Nature, culture and a reason to stay another day. A few ideas for your time around Laubach.

Nature & heritage

Kaulenbachtal ↗

Slate heaps and former mines tell the story of the valley. The Digi-Pfad adds interactive discoveries along the way.

Volcanic Eifel

Ulmen & the maars ↗

A volcanic lake, the Jungferweiher and an unusual connecting tunnel: discover another side of the Eifel in Ulmen.

A day by the Moselle

Cochem ↗

Old-town lanes, the riverside promenade and a castle above the town. A place to take your time.

Timber frames & little lanes

Monreal ↗

Timber-framed houses cluster beside the Elz. Above the village, two castle ruins tell a story of their own.

Vineyards & open views

The Moselle region ↗

One river, so many perspectives: explore wine villages, walks and views such as the Moselle bend near Bremm.

A day in the Hunsrück

Geierlay ↗

A suspension bridge above the valley turns the walk into an experience. Another idea for a day out during your stay.

FOR MOTORSPORT ENTHUSIASTS

Nürburgring.
A day with a different pace.

From events to visitor experiences: plan your day directly with the Nürburgring. Your programme and arrival arrangements depend on the experience you choose.

Excursions are run by independent operators and are not included with the accommodation. Check opening times, trail conditions, directions and booking terms with each operator. The full Wilde Endert route and some castle paths require suitable fitness. Bridge damage has been reported on the Wilde Endert route; the tower of Monreal’s Löwenburg is closed for renovation according to its operator.
